done_when: The coordinator guide that Forge ships tells the coordinator to set a model on every ad-hoc subagent it starts outside Forge's roles (Sonnet for analysis and research, Haiku for sorting and search), and a test checks the shipped guide says so.
why: A coordinator's own ad-hoc subagents without a model, such as the built-in general-purpose agent, inherit the coordinator's model (Opus) for analysis that a cheaper model handles.
